points.text: A boat carrying about 350 people from Djibouti toward Yemen capsized, leaving at least 109 dead and 116 missing; more than 80 survived.
Saudi Arabia reported another attack on Riyadh airport, a day after a strike killed at least 12 people and injured more than 300.
Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed to halt attacks on energy infrastructure; Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the announcement was news to him.
Flash floods along Nepal’s Budhi Gandaki River swept away homes, buildings and bridges; at least five people were missing and residents were evacuated by helicopter.
Pope Leo XIV said he would undergo surgery in the coming days to remove a nodule detected on his lung.
